queries: WITH m AS (SELECT max(tick) t FROM ticks), b AS (SELECT * FROM budget_monthly WHERE tick=(SELECT t FROM m)), p AS (SELECT * FROM power_monthly WHERE tick=(SELECT t FROM m)), w AS (SELECT * FROM water_monthly WHERE tick=(SELECT t FROM m)), mig AS (SELECT * FROM migration_monthly WHERE tick=(SELECT t FROM m)) SELECT m.t, b.balance,b.debt,b.treasury,p.demand_kw,p.supply_kw,p.outage_fraction,p.contract_mode,w.capacity,w.demand,w.load_ratio,w.failure_rate,mig.population,mig.net FROM m,b,p,w,mig

WITH x AS (SELECT tick, avg(condition_score) avg_cond, avg(occupancy) avg_occ, avg(CASE WHEN power_served THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) outage FROM building_monthly GROUP BY tick), c AS (SELECT tick, avg(satisfaction) sat, avg(travel_time) travel, avg(CASE WHEN employed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) emp FROM citizen_monthly GROUP BY tick), r AS (SELECT tick, avg(wear) wear, avg(congestion) cong FROM road_monthly GROUP BY tick), l AS (SELECT tick, income_tax_rate,property_tax_rate,electricity_tariff,road_maintenance_budget,water_sewer_capex,transit_fare,power_contract_mode FROM lever_monthly) SELECT l.tick,l.*,x.avg_cond,x.avg_occ,x.outage,c.sat,c.travel,c.emp,r.wear,r.cong FROM l LEFT JOIN x USING(tick) LEFT JOIN c USING(tick) LEFT JOIN r USING(tick) ORDER BY l.tick DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT tick, income_tax_revenue,property_tax_revenue,utility_revenue,transit_revenue,road_spend,water_sewer_spend,balance,debt,treasury FROM budget_monthly ORDER BY tick DESC LIMIT 12
